description: Defines classes and structures for HTTP response caching and a templated web application class using uWebSockets, including cache management and response handling.

classes.name: CachingHttpResponse
classes.description: Handles caching of HTTP responses, including writing data and ending responses.

classes.name: CachingApp
classes.description: A templated web application class that implements caching logic for HTTP GET requests.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the response buffer.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes the response, sends it, and records creation time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests with caching based on URL and expiry time.
